plan.reason: Fixed plan: investigate the alerting service.

text:
Triage:
- The affected service is "ad" with very high p95 latency (0.98s) and high error ratio (1.8).
- The "ad" service also shows very high CPU utilization (0.98 of its limit).
- No errors found in logs or traces for "ad".
- A recent feature flag change turned on "adHighCpu" flag at 11:38, shortly

hypotheses.rationale: High CPU usage caused by the adHighCpu flag leads to increased latency and errors in the ad service.

internal.title: High Latency in Ad Service Due to CPU Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 11:40 UTC, a high latency alert was triggered for the ad service. Diagnosis identified resource exhaustion caused by high CPU usage flagged by 'adHighCpu'. The flag was disabled at 12:00 UTC, resulting in latency recovery verified by monitoring metrics. The incident was resolved promptly with no further impact.

Timeline:
- 11:40:39 Alert received
- 12:00:22 Diagnosis: CPU resource exhaustion
- 12:00:24 Flag disabled
- 12:00:24 Recovery verified

Severity: SEV3

external.title: Intermittent Latency Issue in Ad Service Resolved
external.body: Between 11:40 and 12:00 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced increased latency when using the ad service. Our team identified and addressed the issue promptly, and service performance has returned to normal. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

output.summary: The ad service experienced increased latency due to CPU resource exhaustion triggered by a configuration flag. Disabling the flag restored normal service performance.
output.impact: Customers experienced increased latency in the ad service for approximately 20 minutes.
output.root_cause: High CPU usage caused by a configuration flag led to resource exhaustion and increased latency in the ad service.
output.resolution: The problematic configuration flag was disabled, resulting in immediate recovery of service latency to normal levels.

lessons.lesson: Monitor CPU usage flags closely and have automated alerts for high CPU flags to enable faster diagnosis and mitigation.
lessons.applies_when: When a high CPU usage flag is enabled causing resource exhaustion in the ad service.

action_items: Implement automated monitoring and alerting for CPU usage flags in the ad service.
Review and optimize configuration flags that impact resource usage.
